comments.body:
If I have pieced together the various quest chains to complete first, they are
A culture of life without water - Lond/Amst/Lisb/Sev, 5Rec, 7Arch, May
Lifestyle on the southern continent - Jakarta AG, 5Srch, 7Arch, 5Unlk
Old Tales of Malaga - Seville AG, Span
Revival of the western Roman empire - Sev AG, Srch4, Appr6, Unlk4
The knight of knights - Mars AG, Span, Fre
The Song of Roland - Lisb/Lond/Sev/Mars, Span, Fre
Sword of Holy Knights - Lisb/Lond/Sev/Mars, Fre, Ital
Durandal - Sev AG; 7Srch, 9Arch, 7Unlock
A German's Footprint - Lisb/Sev/Mars/Gen/Nap AG, Eng, Germ, Arch3
At the end of the Caribbean - Santo Domingo AG, 4Rec, 6Geo, Span

If any of these are not necessary, please indicate which are not.
